info.name: Instacart Catalog Authentication Last Mile Delivery API
Find stores offering last mile delivery

items.docs: Returns an array of stores that offer last mile delivery for the customer's location. Last mile delivery is for pre-packed orders that only require transportation from the store to the customer.

info.name: Reserve a time slot for last mile delivery

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the user in the retailer's system.

items.docs: Previews and reserves a time slot for a last mile delivery order. Used to secure a delivery window before creating the order.

info.name: Create a last mile delivery order

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the user in the retailer's system.

items.docs: Creates a last mile delivery order for a previously reserved time slot. Last mile orders are for pre-packed items that require only delivery from the store to the customer location.

info.name: Stage a last mile delivery order

params.name: order_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the order.

items.docs: Marks a last mile delivery order as staged and ready for pickup by the delivery driver. This should be called when the order items are packed and ready at the store.
